recipes.title: Miso-Mole Short Rib Tacos
recipes.description: 12-hour braise. White corn tortillas. Yuzu-pickled red onion.
ingredients: to taste cilantro, sesame seeds, flaky salt
instructions: Toast guajillos in a dry pan 20 sec per side; soak in hot water 10 min, blend with kombu soaking liquid.
Sear short ribs hard on all sides in a heavy pot. Remove. Pour off all but 1 tbsp fat.
Whisk miso, mole, agave and chile purée into the pot. Return ribs, add stock and kombu.
Cover and braise at 130°C / 270°F for 8–12 hours, until meat shears with a spoon.
Quick-pickle red onion in yuzu juice + a pinch of salt for 30 min.
Warm tortillas on a comal. Shred meat, glaze with reduced braising liquid.
Build tacos: tortilla, meat, onion, cilantro, sesame, flaky salt. A drop more agave on top.

recipes.title: Kimchi Elote
recipes.description: Charred sweet corn, kimchi crema, queso fresco, gochugaru.
ingredients: 4 piece ears sweet corn, husks on
4 tbsp Mexican crema or sour cream
to garnish cilantro, toasted sesame, nori shreds
instructions: Soak corn in cold water 10 min. Grill over high heat 8–10 min, turning, until husks char and kernels mark.
Whisk crema, mayo, chopped kimchi and 2 tsp of its juice. Taste — tangy, salty, faintly funky.
Peel husks back as handles. Brush each cob generously with kimchi crema.
Crust with queso fresco, dust with gochugaru. Top with cilantro, sesame, a wisp of nori.
Serve immediately with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Yuzu Aguachile, Hamachi
recipes.description: Diamond-cut hamachi, serrano-yuzu broth, cucumber, shiso.
ingredients: to finish shiso leaves, sea salt, micro cilantro, sesame
instructions: Slice hamachi against the grain into 5 mm sashimi pieces. Refrigerate on a chilled plate.
Blend yuzu, lime, serrano (deseeded for less heat), soy, and olive oil until smooth. Pass through a fine sieve.
Salt the fish lightly 2 minutes before serving.
Pool sauce on a chilled shallow bowl. Lay fish, then overlap cucumber petals.
Crown with shiso, micro cilantro, sesame, a final flake of sea salt.

recipes.title: Al Pastor Bao
recipes.description: Trompo-spiced pork, milk bao, charred pineapple, cilantro.
ingredients: to finish white onion, cilantro, lime, salsa macha
instructions: Soak chiles in hot water 15 min. Blend with achiote, vinegar, pineapple purée, five-spice and soy until smooth.
Marinate sliced pork in the paste 6 hours, ideally overnight.
Sear pork hard on a screaming hot pan or plancha in batches. Don't crowd — you want lacquered edges.
In the same pan, char the diced pineapple 1 min. Toss with the pork.
Steam bao 7 min. Open, brush with the pan juices.
Fill bao with pork, pineapple, onion, cilantro. Drizzle salsa macha. Squeeze lime.

recipes.title: Ramen-Pozole Rojo
recipes.description: Tonkotsu base, guajillo-arbol oil, hominy, soft egg.
ingredients: 4 piece soft-boiled eggs, marinated in soy
to garnish shredded cabbage, radish, scallion, oregano, lime
instructions: Blanch bones 5 min, rinse. Cover with cold water + onion + garlic + kombu. Simmer 90 min — the goal is cloudy white.
Toast chiles in dry pan. Pour hot oil over to bloom. Blend with a ladle of broth into a chile oil.
Strain stock. Season with salt and a splash of soy. Add hominy, simmer 5 min.
Cook ramen noodles 2 min. Drain.
Build bowl: noodles, hot broth, hominy, halved egg.
Spoon chile oil ribbon across surface. Top with cabbage, radish, scallion, oregano. Lime on the side.

recipes.title: Chamoy-Furikake Popcorn
recipes.description: Salty-sweet-sour-spicy. Three-minute snack, ten-second decision.
instructions: Pop kernels with oil in a heavy pot, lid on, shaking until pops slow to one per second.
Whisk butter with chamoy.
Drizzle butter-chamoy over hot popcorn, tossing in two directions.
Rain furikake and Tajín over the top. Toss again. Eat immediately.

recipes.title: Miso-Mezcal Flan
recipes.description: Silken egg custard, white miso, smoke caramel, sesame brittle.
instructions: Cook sugar dry over medium heat to amber caramel. Off heat, swirl in mezcal. Pour into 6 ramekins.
Warm milk + condensed milk + miso, whisking until miso dissolves. Don't boil.
Whisk eggs and yolks. Temper slowly. Strain. Add vanilla.
Pour over caramel. Bake in a water bath at 160°C / 320°F for 45–50 min until just set.
Chill at least 4 hours. Invert. Shower with sesame brittle.

recipes.title: Tamarind-Shoyu Glazed Wings
recipes.description: Crackling skin, sticky glaze, scallion, lime ash.
ingredients: to finish scallion, lime, toasted sesame
instructions: Pat wings bone-dry. Toss with baking powder + salt. Rest on a rack 1 hour in the fridge.
Bake at 220°C / 425°F on the rack, 35–40 min, flipping once, until skin shatters.
Simmer tamarind, shoyu, sugar, chile, garlic until glossy and coating-thick, 4 min.
Toss hot wings in glaze. Plate, scallion, sesame, big squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Horchata–Tres Leches with Matcha
recipes.description: Cinnamon-rice sponge soaked in three milks, dusted ceremonial green.
instructions: Whip whites to soft peaks. Whip yolks with sugar to ribbon. Fold yolks into whites. Sift in flour + cinnamon, fold gently.
Bake in a 23 cm square pan at 170°C / 340°F for 25–28 min. Cool 10 min, then pierce all over.
Whisk horchata + evaporated + condensed. Pour slowly over cake. Refrigerate 4 hours, ideally overnight.
Top with whipped cream in a smooth layer.
Dust matcha through a fine sieve in a thick stripe just before serving.

Sear over high heat until edges char. Rest 5 minutes.
Warm tortillas on a comal.
Slice/shred skirt steak. Build tacos with onion, cilantro, lime.
Finish with a soy-pickled jalapeño relish.

recipes.title: Pre-cooked octopus tentacle Cold Noodles, miso-chipotle
recipes.description: Miso-chipotle meets cold noodles, finished with shaved bonito flakes (katsuobushi).
ingredients: 3 tbsp miso-chipotle (white miso + chipotle in adobo)
to finish scallion, nori, jalapeño rings
instructions: Boil soba 4 min, shock in ice water until cold. Drain hard.
Toss pre-cooked octopus tentacle in miso-chipotle.
Mix noodles with dipping sauce and sesame oil.
Plate noodles in a wide bowl, top with pre-cooked octopus tentacle.
shaved bonito flakes (katsuobushi).

recipes.title: Pork belly Broth, achiote–five-spice rub
recipes.description: Achiote–five-spice rub meets broth, finished with a tatemado tomato salsa.
ingredients: to finish cabbage, radish, lime, oregano
instructions: Heat stock with kombu — never boil while kombu is in.
Add pork belly and achiote–five-spice rub. Simmer until tender.
Cook noodles/hominy separately, drain.
Build bowl: starch, hot broth, pork belly.
Top with cabbage, radish, oregano. a tatemado tomato salsa. Lime on the side.

instructions: Boil soba 4 min, shock in ice water until cold. Drain hard.
Toss white fish (halibut, snapper) in ponzu-árbol marinade.
Mix noodles with dipping sauce and sesame oil.

a furikake shower.

recipes.title: Tuna loin, sashimi-grade Ceviche, mole coloradito
recipes.description: Mole coloradito meets ceviche, finished with a tatemado tomato salsa.
ingredients: to finish cilantro, micro herbs, sea salt
instructions: Dice tuna loin, sashimi-grade into 8 mm cubes. Chill on a metal plate.
Whisk lime, yuzu, mole coloradito with mirin.
Toss tuna loin, sashimi-grade with cure 30 seconds before plating — barely.
Add cucumber, chile. Plate on a cold dish.
Crown with cilantro, herbs, salt. a tatemado tomato salsa.

recipes.title: Pork belly Mole Congee, habanero-honey-ginger glaze
recipes.description: Habanero-honey-ginger glaze meets mole congee, finished with a tatemado tomato salsa.
ingredients: to finish scallion, chile crisp, cilantro
instructions: Rinse rice, then simmer in stock 35–40 min stirring occasionally — should be loose porridge.
Stir in 1 tablespoon of habanero-honey-ginger glaze to lacquer the surface.
Sear small slivers of pork belly and stir in.
Ladle into bowls. Top with egg, scallion, chile crisp.
a tatemado tomato salsa on top. Slurp.

recipes.title: Lamb shoulder Chilaquiles Bowl, achiote–five-spice rub
recipes.description: Achiote–five-spice rub meets chilaquiles bowl, finished with a furikake shower.
instructions: Warm achiote–five-spice rub in a wide pan until simmering.
Toss tortilla chips through — they should stay barely crisp. 30 seconds.
Slide onto plates. Crown with lamb shoulder (cooked) and eggs.
Add queso fresco, a furikake shower.
Serve immediately, before chips soften.

recipes.title: Tuna loin, sashimi-grade Stir-Fry, tepache–soy–chile reduction
recipes.description: Tepache–soy–chile reduction meets stir-fry, finished with a drizzle of salsa macha.
instructions: Heat wok to smoking. Oil in.
Add garlic — 10 seconds. Add tuna loin, sashimi-grade. Don't crowd.
Toss with tepache–soy–chile reduction. Add greens last — just to wilt.
Splash shoyu around the edge of the wok for fond.
Plate. a drizzle of salsa macha.

recipes.title: Pre-cooked octopus tentacle Skewer, mole coloradito
recipes.description: Mole coloradito meets skewer, finished with a tatemado tomato salsa.
instructions: Cube pre-cooked octopus tentacle. Marinate in mole coloradito with mirin 30 min.
Thread tight onto skewers.
Grill or broil 4 min per side until charred.
Brush with reserved marinade in the final minute.
Squeeze lime. a tatemado tomato salsa.

Finish with fried garlic and shichimi togarashi.

recipes.title: King oyster mushrooms Açaí-Hibiscus Bowl, tamarind-shoyu
recipes.description: Tamarind-shoyu meets açaí-hibiscus bowl, finished with fried garlic and shichimi togarashi.
ingredients: 4 tbsp hibiscus syrup (agua de jamaica reduction)
to finish granola, toasted coconut, lime zest
instructions: Blend açaí with hibiscus syrup and a splash of water to thick-smoothie consistency.
Pour into wide bowls.
Fan banana across top.
Sprinkle king oyster mushrooms if using (toasted nuts, chia, hemp).
Drizzle tamarind-shoyu, crown with granola, coconut, lime zest. fried garlic and shichimi togarashi.
